root_text: For the first time in Bangladesh, a woman infected with The Human Metapneumo Virus (HMPV) died while undergoing treatment at Mohakhali Infectious Diseases Hospital. It is known that the name of the 30-year-old woman is Sanjida Akhter. ©TDC
